posts.title: Welcome to the aboveground world, brave voyager (Neocicada hieroglyphica)
posts.description: Behold! The vacant skin of a Hieroglyphic Cicada (aka Neocicada hieroglyphica) anchored to the bark of a tree in the heart of the New Jersey Pine Barrens! Zoom in!! Can you see the holes that once supported the legs of the cicada? See the thin, white filaments? Those were its breathing tubes. Imagination time! Compare […]

posts.title: It would not be summer in New Jersey without Swamp Cicadas (Neotibicen tibicen tibicen)
posts.description: Cicadas are a key atmospheric element of summertime in New Jersey (and most States for that matter). Whether you realize it or not, the daytime summer soundtrack of your yard, parks and hiking trails includes the song of cicadas. Cicadas rule the day and crickets and katydids rule the night.
